A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CompMarkGS work and are readable, including their figures and equations. v1 contains supplementary material on PDF pages 12–23; the supplied v4 ends after the references. This is an observable document omission, not an extraction failure.

before.justification: v1 reports original watermarking, rendering-quality, compression, robustness, and ablation results in the main paper and supplement.

after.justification: v4 retains the original experiments in Section 5, including quantitative comparisons in Tables 1–7 and qualitative results.

M1.justification: The proposed anchor-feature watermark embedding, quantization distortion layer, frequency-aware anchor growing, decoder procedure, and objectives remain unchanged in Section 4. Omitting supplementary implementation explanations does not establish an algorithm change.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same 25 scenes from Blender, LLFF, and Mip-NeRF 360, with the same watermarking and distortion tasks. The omitted supplement varies compression and attack parameters within this coverage and provides additional dataset-level results.

E2.justification: v1 Supplementary Section 2 and Figure 1 compare GaussianMarker with and without the proposed QDL under HAC and ContextGS; this evaluated variant comparison disappears. The main comparisons retain WateRF, GaussianMarker, and 3D-GSW unchanged.

E3.justification: v4 omits supplementary compression-size sweeps and model-attack sweeps covering noise standard deviations 0.001–0.005, cloning 10–70%, and pruning 10–50%. The retained experiments preserve their splits, metrics, message lengths, and fixed attack settings. Missing training-schedule disclosures do not establish changed training.

E4.justification: The supplement's QDL transfer experiment on GaussianMarker, compression-performance sensitivity analysis, and separate HAC/ContextGS attack-strength analyses are removed. These test component transferability and robustness beyond the retained fixed-setting comparisons and CompMarkGS ablations.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. Dataset averages and attack-noise standard deviations are not estimates of experimental uncertainty.

E6.justification: Main Tables 1–7 remain unchanged, but substantial supplementary results disappear: dataset-specific scores, QDL-transfer outcomes, compression and attack-strength curves, and annotated renderings. For example, Supplementary Table 1 reports HAC+CompMarkGS post-compression accuracy of 96.77%, 98.53%, and 92.35% on Mip-NeRF 360, LLFF, and Blender; these individual entries are absent from v4.

T1.justification: The explicit definitions of the Scaffold-GS reconstruction loss and volume regularizer in v1 Supplementary Equations (1a–b) are omitted. The main mathematical formulation remains unchanged, including its use of that reconstruction loss; neither version contains theoretical guarantees or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same novelty, compression robustness, rendering-quality, and watermarking claims. Changing 'Compression' to 'Compressed' in the title does not alter their scientific scope.

C2.justification: v4 loses the supplement's explanation attributing clone/prune robustness to training-time pruning and anchor growing, and its discussion of QDL's applicability to GaussianMarker. Main interpretations and the stated limitation requiring a pretrained decoder remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Supplementary Section 1 is omitted, removing the 30,000-iteration schedule, watermark-training start after 20,000 iterations, anchor-growing interval of 1,600–15,000, reconstruction-loss weights, and detailed growing/pruning rules. Baseline adaptation and fine-tuning explanations also disappear, substantially reducing reproducibility information.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, research positioning, and cited works remain unchanged. Bibliographic differences remove supplementary citation-page backlinks rather than references or substantive relationships to prior work.

P1.justification: v4 removes the complete supplementary document, including its overview and four organized sections, substantially contracting the document structure. The main prose is otherwise unchanged apart from the title correction and version/date text, and still refers readers to supplementary details.

P2.justification: Supplementary Table 1 and Figures 1–13 disappear, removing the dataset-level table, sensitivity plots, QDL comparison, and extensive rendering/difference-map panels. The main figures, tables, and layout are retained.

improvement.justification: The supplied v4 substantially reduces reproducibility and evidential depth by omitting the training schedule, component-transfer checks, compression and attack-strength sweeps, and dataset-level results. Its unchanged main text still directs readers to missing supplementary details in Sections 4.3–4.4. The title correction offers little benefit against these losses, although the core method and main results remain intact.
